## Corrections and mathematical checks

Rational pole clearing does not require the input image set to contain all conjugates: powers of rational minimal polynomials also work for an unsaturated finite algebraic set. The singleton √2 with polynomial `(t²−2)^m` discriminates the former unnecessary assumption. The changed proof sketch, regression and roadmap layer say the same thing.

The important native-interface correction is at V0. `MeromorphicAt` concerns a punctured germ. Its nonnegative order permits an analytic extension, but does not force a totalized scalar representative to take the extension's value at the centre. Thus pole-count nonnegativity requires a regular **germ**, not a finite chosen scalar value; zero pole count gives removable germs, and pointwise holomorphicity additionally requires continuity. The native nonnegative-order/analytic-extension equivalence and meromorphic-plus-continuous theorem already exist. They are cited directly rather than replanned.

The auxiliary regression in the suggested file proves, without admissions, that the function taking value 2 at zero and 1 elsewhere is globally meromorphic in the native sense, has order zero and divisor zero everywhere, and has zero disc-local pole count, yet is neither continuous nor analytic at zero. Its seven lemmas concern this interface distinction only, not the roadmap's unproved results.

Source locators and matches are corrected for the local inversion/translation identities, power scaling, pivot chain and bounds, and final absorption. The regular-centre excerpt's missing not-equal glyph is restored against the published p.679 image. The source invokes rather than proves the complex log-Gamma Taylor theorem; the explicit small-radius choice is an independently checked adapter; effective all-radius fixed-level constants are stronger than the quoted asymptotic. Each such proof boundary remains an honest gap.

The definitions' 68 API items and 54 tests were checked against their uses and native conventions. In particular: the boundary Blaschke factor is constant −a; the empty product is one and strict disc image needs an interior factor; logarithmic reconstruction retains phase; hypergeometric continuation is not the native series outside its radius; Gamma uniformization is guarded by N≥2; local divisors are not extended globally; centre pole weights use a separate logarithmic term; the pivot denominator is guarded. All 41 planets name actual definitions, constructions or central theorems.

## Sources, suppliers and retained gaps

The primary source is the [published CDT offprint](https://www.math.uchicago.edu/~fcale/papers/UDC.pdf), JAMS 38 (2025), 627–702, DOI 10.1090/jams/1053, SHA-256 `867026fbcc5592728173e5c4d6a87f58d57a55b0d0d8b0109b9774e84290ee1e`. Independently read scope: §1.1.6 p.632; §1.1.8 p.634; Corollary 2.0.5 proof p.636; Lemma 2.3.1 and Remark 2.3.3 pp.639–641; Lemma 4.2.2 proof p.655; the whole of §5 pp.667–678; §6.1–6.2 pp.679–684. The p.678 and p.679 page images were additionally inspected. This is not a whole-paper reading or a reading of every cited original book/article.

All six inherited findings were checked and have independent confirmed verdicts: the Euler sign, shifted digamma coefficient, outer radius, rotated exceptional set/full-group Shimizu scope, quotient phase and logarithmic supremum. E17 records a missing reciprocal in the published p.678 diameter estimate. From the exact diameter and the projective-entry lower bound, the intended estimate is `E≤4h²/D`, hence the inner-disc exclusion is unchanged. The reciprocal is absent in the page image, not merely OCR. No novelty claim is made.

Bounded correction checks on 2026-10-05 used the [first author's research page](https://www.math.uchicago.edu/~fcale/research.html), current linked offprint, [arXiv version listing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.09040), [Crossref DOI metadata](https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1090/jams/1053), and title/author erratum/corrigendum queries. The listing ends at v4; only selected web-extracted v4 proof text was compared, not its whole PDF or page image. The author-page erratum entry refers to another paper. No applicable correction was found; these searches do not establish absence. Nothing was sent to the authors.

All 40 baseline declarations were checked in their actual Lean source at Mathlib `082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174` and Tau Ceti `f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369`, including relevant namespaces and ambient hypotheses across 19 distinct original modules. The three additions are `MeromorphicAt`, `MeromorphicAt.meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg_iff` and `MeromorphicAt.analyticAt`. The archived receipt identifies each declaration, line, module hash, pin and use. Declaration-index SHA-256 is `86649a7d5f35d1178a45fe7aa4713741d03d43ff3b37bb8c91a1da1c794c8ce1`.

Supplier statements were personally checked for all eight requested stages: ConformalMapping L2/L3/L4; UniversalCovers stages 1/2; FuchsianOrbifolds L0/L2/L3. The local reviewed library audit was consulted. Existing cover, continuation, projective-action and cusp infrastructure is reused; analytic surface uniformization and quantitative Shimizu are not claimed supplied just because nearby qualitative infrastructure exists. The Shimizu extension stays with FuchsianOrbifolds Part II, while only its specialization belongs here.

Current upstream PRs #24161 and #43859 were separately inspected, at heads `01d32bb7a38c19914993269bd1a45d9a553bb0c1` and `ad53e0af8ad54dc985ce5f8c5b0e053907f5fdda`. Neither is in the pinned baseline. In particular, the newer positive-log mean estimate with log-2 error is not substituted for the sharper entropy constant needed here.

The 15 gaps still cover complex ODE existence, analytic surface uniformization and cusp orientation, Hempel descent, boundary Blaschke smoothing, hypergeometric differentiation/connection/uniform parameter tails, local log-Gamma convergence, polygon identification, quantitative Shimizu/effective cusp constants, local divisor and logarithmic integrability, radial subharmonicity, and effective finite-level completion. Original Hempel, Abramowitz–Stegun, Goluzin, Carathéodory, EGM, Tsuji and Kraus–Roth proofs were not all read; no such claim is made.

## Orchestrator handoff

Please refresh `research/blueprint/readmes/ConformalMappingPartII.md` from the corrected packet/roadmap before publishing the reader: this review issue authorizes only its report, roadmap, packet and suggested file, not that reader. Required synchronization includes rational pole clearing, the native germ/continuity distinction, exact source matches and E17. The existing reader was not read in full or certified synchronized. This is a reader-refresh request, not permission to hide the retained mathematical gaps. No other deliverables or atlas data were changed.

The review's public receipts and replay helpers are authenticated below, so transient scratch can be removed recoverably after submission without losing its reproducible evidence. Source PDFs/page images and downloaded primary-library PR code are intentionally not embedded. All code for the mathematical regression is in the authorized suggested file, not this report.

The archived `common.py` and validator are portable variants of the executed helpers: private machine paths are replaced by `TAUCETI_REPO` and `TAUCETI_INDEX`. Set those to an existing read-only repository/object database and the pinned declaration index. The original executed algorithm is otherwise unchanged. Recover files to a new disk scratch directory using `apply_patch`, then copy the public final packet, roadmap and suggested file into that scratch (renaming them as the helpers expect). Run `python3 validate_review.py`; for a serial Lean replay run `python3 runcheck.py <scratch> <existing-pinned-mathlib> <pinned-lean> Suggested.lean`. The helper refuses less than 20 GiB available memory and never builds dependencies.
